study type: Regression discontinuity analysis of routine data
exposure: mild hyperglycaemia (with an FPG of 5.1-5.5 mmol/l)
cohort: 7062 women with singleton pregnancies screened for GDM who gave birth at ≥24 weeks of gestation between 2017-2019
finding: While higher FPG was associated with increased birthweight and LGA risk, GDM diagnosis significantly reduced both, suggesting that GDM treatment mitigates the adverse effects of hyperglycemia.
